what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Algeria in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12949 asylum seekers from Algeria.
Canada hosts the largest share, 46.1%, followed by Ireland, Germany and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Algeria from 1995 to 2018, at war level in some years, with the AIS, GIA, AQIM and MUJAO among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with AQIM in 2020 and with the Islamic State group in 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 2320 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 13598, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2016 and 2018 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Algeria are counted separately.
